_comment: Content of a conversation reward. ConversationRewards.gd owns ELIGIBILITY (state-gated, anti-farm); this file owns WHAT is paid out. Gold and consumables only, on purpose: equipment ids must reach GameLoop.equipment_pool through the resolver QuestSystem owns, and a fifth copy of that resolver is a separate change. An id that does not resolve in items.json is refused loudly here rather than granted as a dead inventory entry, which is the exact failure the quest reward path hit with returned_sword.
